description: New certification listings have revealed additional details about Samsung's upcoming Galaxy A08 4G ahead of its expected launch. The handset has appeared on the FCC database with information about its battery, charging support, connectivity, and design, while separate Wi-Fi Alliance listings hint at Galaxy M08 4G and Galaxy F08 4G variants. The trio was previously spotted on the BIS website, indicating that an India launch may be approaching, although Samsung has not confirmed an official release schedule.
title: Samsung Galaxy A08 4G, Galaxy M08, and Galaxy F08 Surface in New Listings

description: WhatsApp for Android users can soon edit captions on their status updates. This feature is said to be available for beta testers now with the WhatsApp beta for Android 2.26.30.1 update. It would help users to easily correct typos or other mistakes without deleting and reposting the status. Users can access the edit option from two different locations and have up to 15 minutes after posting to make changes.
title: WhatsApp Adds Status Caption Editing Feature for Android Beta Testers: Report

description: Hong Kong’s Monetary Authority has introduced a new assessment framework and the Quantum Preparedness Index (QPI) to evaluate banks’ resilience against future quantum computing threats. The move comes as the city expands tokenised deposits, digital assets, and blockchain-based settlement systems. The regulator aims to raise the banking sector’s preparedness to the highest level by 2030 while encouraging the adoption of post-quantum security measures across financial institutions.
title: Banks in Hong Kong Brace for Quantum Risks During Tokenisation Expansion

description: Fresh reports have raised concerns about Claude's public sharing feature after some shared Artifacts remained searchable through Google. While shared conversations were no longer visible in Google's search results, apps, documents, spreadsheets, dashboards, and other AI-generated content created with Claude could still be discovered online. Anthropic said content is private by default and only becomes public when users generate shareable links. The reports have renewed debate over how AI platforms present public sharing features and search engine visibility.
title: Claude Artifacts Found in Google Search, Raising Fresh Privacy Concerns

description: Pixel 11 series price and battery details leaked online. As per the leak, the Pixel 11 will cost GBP 879 (roughly Rs. 1,12,000) for the 256GB storage model. The Pixel 11 Pro is said to cost GBP 1,079, while the Pixel 11 Pro XL is tipped to be priced at GBP 1,279. The Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL are said to feature 4,985mAh, 4,850mAh, and 5,115mAh batteries, respectively.
title: Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL Price, Battery Capacities Leaked Online

description: Meta has started rolling out the latest software update for the Meta Ray-Ban Display Glasses, bringing new abilities and features to the smart glasses. With the new software update, the Meta Ray-Ban Display Glasses users will be able to browse their Threads feed, view media, engage with posts, share to messaging, and use voice commands within the apps, directly from their smart glasses. On top of this, the update also introduces the ability to share photos clicked using the Meta Ray-Ban Display Glasses to Instants, Instagram’s recently launched feed that appears in the messages window, directly from the smart glasses.
title: Meta Ray-Ban Display Glasses Updated With Ability to Browse Threads, Use Meta AI’s Muse Spark and More

description: Capcom has reported a strong first quarter of its fiscal year 2026, driven by the sales of its games. Resident Evil Requiem has crossed 8 million copies sold, while Pragmata has surpassed 2.5 million units sold. Capcom has registed a year-on-year increase in net sales and operating profit in the quarter.
title: Resident Evil Requiem Sales Cross 8 Million Copies as Pragmata Surpasses 2.5 Million Units, Capcom Confirms

description: Apple is facing a lawsuit in the US after three users alleged they lost a combined $1.8 million by downloading a fake Bitcoin wallet application from the App Store. The plaintiffs claim Apple failed to prevent the counterfeit app despite promoting the App Store as a secure platform. Apple said it has since removed the fake applications and developer accounts while highlighting its app review process and efforts to block fraudulent software.
title: Apple Sued After Users Allegedly Lose $1.8 Million to Fake Bitcoin Wallet App

description: Apple has long been rumoured to be developing a MacBook Pro with an OLED screen, and it could finally see the light of day this year. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has kept details under wraps, a new report suggests that Samsung could be the sole supplier of the OLED panel of the MacBook Pro. The purported laptop is rumoured to be offered in 14-inch and 16-inch models, equipped with a two-stack tandem OLED structure and integrated touch technology.
title: Apple's Touchscreen MacBook Pro Models to Exclusively Use Samsung OLED Displays: Report

description: Honor has begun taking pre-orders for the Band 11 series in China, adding a new Pro GPS Edition to the lineup. The latest range includes three models and introduces standalone GPS support for the first time in the series. Honor has also confirmed battery life figures, colour options, badminton mode, and sleep health monitoring across the lineup. While reservations are now open through official channels, the company is yet to announce pricing, the official launch date, and the complete specifications.
title: Honor Band 11 Series Opens for Pre-Orders in China With New Pro GPS Model

description: Huawei Nova 16 SE could launch soon with an Honor Power 2-inspired design. The upcoming handset is tipped to feature an LTPS OLED flat screen with 1.5K resolution. It could run on a Kirin 8020 chip. The Huawei Nova 16 SE is likely to come with a 50-megapixel primary rear camera with Red Maple imaging technology. It could include an 8,500mAh battery. Huawei Nova 16 SE is tipped to be priced around CNY 2,000 (roughly Rs. 28,000).
title: Huawei Nova 16 SE Leak Reveals Design, Price, and Key Specifications Ahead of Launch

description: Project Perception has been unveiled by the Redmond-based tech giant, Microsoft, the company announced on Monday. Project Perception, which aims to provide enhanced protection against AI-powered cyber threats, uses specialised AI models and agents to defend against them. The cyber stack “brings together signals, context, models and specialised agents”, which can reason, prioritise, and autonomously take action against such threats. The Project Perception coordinates three classes of specialised agents, namely Red, Blue, and Green team agents. The Red team agents are built to identify ways through which a bad actor can exploit to compromise an organisation's tech architecture.
title: Microsoft Introduces Project Perception as a New Agentic Security System to Protect Against AI-Powered Cyberattacks

description: The tension between delivering AI experiences to users for free and managing escalating cloud infrastructure costs has sparked a crucial industry question: How long can mobile AI remain free, and what will monetisation look like when the bill comes due? To understand where the market is headed, Gadgets 360 spoke directly with JB Park, CEO and President of Samsung Southwest Asia, about the company's long-term monetisation roadmap for Galaxy AI.
title: Exclusive: Samsung's JB Park on Galaxy AI Costs, Monetisation, and What Stays Free

description: Oppo Reno 16 series x Baby Monster edition will be launched in India soon, the smartphone maker announced on Tuesday. The Oppo Reno 16 Series x Baby Monster Edition will ship with a themed retail box, which will include a smartphone, a themed protective case, cards with the pictures of the group members, and other accessories. Moreover, the microsites reveal that the specifications and features of the special edition will be identical to the standard edition. The company will also not make any design changes.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Series x Baby Monster Edition India Launch Teased: What You Need to Know

description: Boat Sailor Nav was launched in India on Tuesday. The homegrown wearables brand claims it marks its foray into the kids' lifestyle technology segment. The smartwatch has a 1.4-inch HD display and is offered in two colour options. It supports real-time Google Maps location tracking with geo-fencing and five-point satellite positioning features. There are also two-way video and voice calls over a built-in 4G SIM, along with SOS alerts and audio chats. Alongside, Boat has also announced Sailor Play wireless headphones for children.
title: Boat Sailor Nav Smartwatch Launched in India With Google Maps Tracking Alongside Sailor Play Headphones

description: Ubisoft has reportedly begun development on a new Far Cry game, said to be an "ambitious" open-world first-person shooter. The game is reportedly codenamed Kodiak and completed its conceptualisation phase earlier this month. The new Far Cry game is separate from the next mainline Far Cry title also in development at Ubisoft's Vantage Studios.
title: New 'Ambitious' Open-World Far Cry Game Reportedly Enters Development at Ubisoft

description: Lenovo has disclosed the display specifications of the upcoming Legion Y700 AI tablet through new Weibo teasers ahead of its China launch. The gaming-focused tablet will feature an 8.4-inch OLED display with a 165Hz refresh rate, Dolby Vision support, and several eye protection technologies. Lenovo has also detailed gaming-oriented touch features and display certifications. Earlier teasers confirmed that the tablet will use the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Leading Version chipset, support 5G connectivity, and include AI-powered features.
title: Lenovo Legion Y700 AI Display Specifications Revealed Ahead of August Debut

description: Honor Robot Phone is confirmed to come with a triple rear camera system comprising a 200-megapixel primary 1/1.28-inch CMOS sensor, a 50-megapixel ultra-wide camera and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto lens. The upcoming handset will feature the company's in-house Honor Yuguang H1 imaging chip. The company has partnered with ARRI for the new model. It is currently available for pre-reservations in China in two colour options and two RAM and storage options.
title: Honor Robot Phone Camera Details, RAM and Storage Variants Teased; Pre-Orders Begin

description: OnePlus N6x will go on sale in India on August 4 at 12 pm IST, the smartphone maker confirmed on Tuesday. The handset maker has also revealed that the OnePlus N6x will be equipped with a flat display, which will deliver a refresh rate of up to 120Hz. A phone will also ship with multiple AI photo editing tools, namely AI Portrait Glow, AI Eraser, and AI Unblur. The AI Portrait Glow is claimed to allow users to increase the brightness of subject faces in images that were clicked in dimly lit environments. On the other hand, the AI Eraser tool will let users remove unwanted elements from an image. Similarly, the AI Unblur functionality on the OnePlus N6x will increase the sharpness of blurred images.
title: OnePlus N6x Sale Date, Key Features Confirmed Ahead of India Launch

description: Vivo introduced a Fusion Red colourway of the Vivo T5x 5G in India on Tuesday. The handset was initially launched in the country in March in Cyber Green and Star Silver colour options. It is, however, only a cosmetic change, and it retains the specifications of the existing variants. The Vivo T5x 5G is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset. It sports a 6.76-inch LCD screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. The handset packs a 7,200mAh battery.
title: Vivo T5x 5G Fusion Red Colourway Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Oppo India's Goldee Patnaik, Head of Communications, talks about premiumisation and the power of AI. He also touches on the company's 110% growth for the Reno series.
title: Inside Oppo India’s Strategy for a Saturated, High-ASP Smartphone Market

description: Bitcoin traded below $64,000 as rising Treasury yields and investor caution ahead of the US Federal Reserve’s policy decision weighed on crypto markets. Analysts said ETF outflows and macroeconomic uncertainty continue to limit upside despite supportive on-chain signals.
title: Bitcoin Drops Below $64,000 as Treasury Yields Pressure Crypto Market

description: Snapchat has rolled out Now Playing, a Snap Map feature that lets users share their live Spotify listening activity with friends. After linking a Spotify account, users can choose who can view their music status and interact with tracks by opening them in Spotify, saving them to Liked Songs, or exploring related Spotlight videos. The update also supports saving songs from Spotlight and Sound Pages directly to Spotify. It is available where both Snapchat and Spotify operate, with Canada to follow.
title: Snapchat Brings Spotify Music Sharing to Snap Map With Now Playing

description: Redmi Note 17 5G will be launched in India on August 6, the Xiaomi sub-brand revealed on Tuesday. The smartphone maker has also confirmed that the Redmi Note 17 5G will be equipped with an 8,000mAh battery. It will also sport an AMOLED display. The handset will be available for purchase in the country via Amazon and the Xiaomi India online store. It will be offered in blue and pink colour options. More details are expected to be revealed in the coming days. This comes shortly after the company started teasing the launch of a new Note series smartphone.
title: Redmi Note 17 5G India Launch Revealed Along With Battery, Display Features: Expected Specifications

description: Following the launch of the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Fold 8 Ultra, and Z Flip 8 last week, the rumour mill is now shifting towards Samsung’s next-generation Galaxy S lineup. While the purported handsets are still months away from launch, leaks surrounding their hardware have started surfacing online. A new report sheds light on the battery capacities of the Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra, which are expected to sit above the Plus model in Samsung’s next-generation flagship lineup.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro, Galaxy S27 Ultra Battery Capacities Leak; Could Get Silicon-Carbon Technology

description: A new leak suggests Nothing is preparing to introduce its first smartwatch under the main Nothing brand. Tipster Yogesh Brar claims the wearable could launch in September with the company's signature design language, a price below $300 (roughly Rs. 28,700), and availability in select markets. Nothing has not confirmed the report. The company currently sells smartwatches through its CMF sub-brand, whose latest model, the CMF Watch 3 Pro, offers AMOLED display, dual-band GPS, AI fitness features, and up to 13 days of battery life.
title: Nothing Might Be Working on Its First Smartwatch, Tipped to Launch in September

description: iOS 26.6 is currently available. Users with iPhone 11 and later can install the update. iPhone users can also manually check for it by heading to Settings > General > Software Update and selecting Update Now. The update includes bug fixes and security patches. It also optimises the Spotlight search index, getting it ready for iOS 27.
title: Apple Rolls Out iOS 26.6 With Security Fixes and Spotlight Improvements

description: Amazon Great Freedom 2026 is scheduled to commence on August 7, the e-commerce giant recently announced. A dedicated microsite for the upcoming sale event was recently made live in the country, revealing various details about the sale event. Like its previous sale events, the e-commerce giant is expected to offer a number of gadgets from different categories, like smartphones, smart TVs, tablets, laptops, true wireless stereo (TWS) headsets, washing machines, refrigerators, air conditioners, microwaves, and other home appliances at relatively low prices during the Amazon Great Freedom Sale.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale: Start Date, HDFC Bank Discount, and What to Expect

description: Redmi has officially confirmed its presence at ChinaJoy 2026. The company will unveil a new product at the event. While the company has not disclosed the name of the device, the long-rumoured Redmi K100 series is expected to make its first public appearance during the event. The Redmi K100 series is believed to include the standard Redmi K100, K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max. The lineup is tipped to run on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: Redmi K100 Series Debut Seems Imminent as Firm Starts Teasing the Launch of a New Smartphone

description: Xbox has fixed a major outage on its platform that prevented users from signing in, playing games, and completing purchases. The company said the issue originated from a failure in a licensing service that sits outside of Xbox. Xbox is now reviewing the incident to prevent similar outages in the future.
title: Xbox Fixes Major Outage That Prevented Users From Signing In, Launching Games

description: The Flipkart Freedom Sale has been announced in India. The e-commerce platform's Independence Day-themed sale event will begin on August 8. During the sale period, eligible customers will be able to avail of discounts across smartphones, laptops, tablets, televisions, home appliances, and other electronics. Flipkart has teased offers on products such as the iPhone 17, Samsung Galaxy S25, Motorola Edge 70 Fusion, and Samsung Galaxy Tab A11+, which are set to receive discounts.
title: Flipkart Freedom Sale Starts August 8: Bank Offers and Deals Teased

description: The Redmi Note 17 series is expected to make its way to India and global markets soon. The latest Note-series lineup was introduced in the Xiaomi sub-brand’s home market of China earlier this month, while the company has also recently begun teasing its debut in India. Ahead of its anticipated launch, however, pricing and configuration details of four Redmi Note 17 series models for the global market reportedly have surfaced online.
title: Redmi Note 17, Note 17 Pro, Note 17 Pro Max European Prices Reportedly Leak Ahead of Launch
